scope: Ten previously identified studies only. Unreviewed candidates and unresolved eligibility remain open; no global inclusion list, denominator or method codes.

rows.label: Man 2011
rows.reason: Original rutile (110) OER calculations explicitly report theoretical CHE overpotentials.
rows.second_pass_remaining: The article suffices for eligibility. Any missing SI still matters for later full methods access.

rows.label: Inico 2024
rows.reason: Rutile (110) OER intermediate calculations and CHE are established, but an explicitly reported CHE overpotential is not established in the inspected article; SI is missing.
first_pass_remaining: Missing SI could contain the required reported CHE overpotential; do not derive an overpotential from intermediate energies and call it reported.
rows.second_pass_remaining: Acquire and inspect the actual SI and relevant graphical material before deciding the reporting criterion. Do not derive eta from intermediate energies or exclude from keyword absence.

rows.label: Feng 2025
rows.reason: The study includes a neutral CHE comparison on RuO2 (110) and explicitly reports its theoretical overpotential, alongside constant-potential calculations.
rows.second_pass_remaining: Preserve Feng as the verified identity rather than the earlier Inico misassignment. The neutral CHE arm supplies eligibility; experimental or constant-potential overpotentials are not substitutes.

rows.label: Gauthier 2017
rows.reason: Original CHE-based IrO2 (110) OER calculations are present; an explicitly reported CHE overpotential has not been established from the available article.
first_pass_remaining: Do not convert a 1.8 eV step to eta by subtracting 1.23 V and treat that as a reported overpotential.
A zero-result Figshare DOI search does not prove no SI exists.
rows.second_pass_remaining: Verify the publisher's complete article/SI inventory and inspect relevant figures. Do not convert the reported 1.8 eV step to a new overpotential. An empty Figshare search does not prove no SI exists.

rows.label: Tripkovic 2018
rows.reason: The article and full nine-page SI study perovskite (001) surfaces, not rutile-oxide (110) OER.
rows.second_pass_remaining: No eligibility access gap remains for the facet exclusion. This is not an exclusion based on the title alone.

rows.label: Exner 2020
rows.reason: The Viewpoint contains a new theoretical descriptor analysis using previously published rutile (110) data. Whether this qualifies as primary research under the fixed rule requires reconciliation; the publication label alone is insufficient.
first_pass_remaining: Determine whether the study is qualifying primary computational research under the frozen rule despite reliance on earlier energetics.
Confirm whether the article/SI actually reports the required CHE eta for the qualifying rutile arm; do not substitute applied operating overpotential or Gmax.
rows.second_pass_remaining: Reconcile the primary-research criterion against the actual original theoretical contribution and secondary-data use. Do not automatically exclude every Viewpoint or automatically count every paper citing rutile CHE data. No method outcomes are relevant to this decision.

rows.label: Xu 2015
rows.reason: Original rutile (110) OER calculations explicitly report CHE overpotential points in Figure 4.
rows.second_pass_remaining: The article establishes eligibility; any later SI access gap is a separate methods-access matter.

rows.label: Divanis 2020
rows.reason: Original TiO2 (110) calculations and a graphical OER overpotential are confirmed. The rutile polymorph still needs a direct primary-source locator rather than assuming it from TiO2 (110).
first_pass_remaining: Establish the rutile polymorph of the new doped-TiO2(110) calculation arm from primary text or unambiguous structural evidence; the facet label alone is insufficient.
rows.second_pass_remaining: Confirm the rutile identity from the structural figures or an unambiguous original structure source. The article is accessible through official HTML despite direct PDF retrieval failure; do not label it inaccessible. The perspective title does not remove its original calculation component.

rows.label: Garcia-Mota 2011
rows.reason: Original transition-metal substitution calculations on rutile TiO2 (110) explicitly tabulate CHE overpotentials.
rows.second_pass_remaining: The article suffices for eligibility. Do not treat earlier literature volcano context as the sole evidence when the primary results already contain an eta table.

rows.label: Mom 2014
rows.reason: Only SI is available. It identifies rutile calculations and explains how to calculate an overpotential from energies, but the required facet and an explicitly reported CHE overpotential require the missing article.
first_pass_remaining: Article full-text access remains unresolved; do not turn missing access into exclusion or negative method codes.
rows.second_pass_remaining: Obtain the primary article and inspect its surface definition and reported overpotentials. Do not derive eta from the SI or exclude on missing article access.
